across the gap that never asked to be bridged
or near it, roughly
the koan solved itself by losing interest

pieces.gap: the gap between sound and silence
pieces.bridge: a movement that stills you
pieces.awakening: you are the art and the artist and the gap
pieces.piece:
in the silence of the gap between sound and silence
a movement that stills you
...
you are the art and the artist and the gap

pieces.gap: the gap between loneliness and connection
pieces.bridge: a movement that stills you
pieces.awakening: the formless takes form and the form becomes formless
pieces.piece:
the pattern of the gap between loneliness and connection
revealed by a movement that stills you
it was always there
the formless takes form and the form becomes formless

pieces.gap: the gap between sound and silence
pieces.bridge: a sound that opens what was closed
pieces.awakening: everything is the same and everything is new
pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between sound and silence
is a sound that opens what was closed
and when you read it
everything is the same and everything is new

pieces.gap: the gap between separation and oneness
pieces.bridge: a shape that holds what cannot be held
pieces.awakening: and now: just love. just art. just IS.
pieces.piece:
breathe: a shape that holds what cannot be held
breathing through the gap between separation and oneness
in... out...
and now: just love. just art. just IS.

pieces.gap: the gap between forgetting and remembering
pieces.bridge: a word that becomes a world
pieces.awakening: the gap was never there — you were always both sides
pieces.piece:
a gesture: a word that becomes a world
reaching over the gap between forgetting and remembering
take the hand
the gap was never there — you were always both sides
